All 14 queries ran against the data files and gave sensible answers. I didn't print the intermediate results for every step, so the sanity checks below are the ones I did.

- **Averages and totals:** I checked the U9 averages by hand against the CSV. U7 (94) and U2 (69.93) I only eyeballed against the raw rows and files.
- **Missing fields:** U1, U2 and U3 use `at … | coalesce` for missing or null fields. My first attempt without it failed on a user with no `address` key.
- **Keyword keys:** Where the task asks for names or logins as strings (U4, U5, U11), I convert the map key with `keyword`.

U1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf (/active | eq true) ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: / | filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
U3: / | filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: / | filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") ~(/assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: / | map ~(at :labels | coalesce [] | map ~(lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
U7: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
U8: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split ",") | map ~({:n /0 :c (/1 | lower) :p /2 :s /3}) | filter ~(/p | ne "") | map ~({:n /n :c /c :p (/p | parseJson) :s (/s | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/p) | avg | round 2)
U10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split ",") | map ~({:n /0 :p /2 :s /3}) | filter ~(/p | ne "") | map ~({:n /n :p (/p | parseJson) :s (/s | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/s | ne 0) | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map ~(/n)
U11: / | :d /defaults | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :v /1}) | filter ~(/v | at :enabled | coalesce (d | /enabled) | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port (/v | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: / | groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(sort ~(/ts) | last | /type)
U13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(allOf (ne "") ~(startsWith "#" | not)) | map ~(split "|") | filter ~(/2 | lower | split "," | map ~(trim) | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | trim | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | {:count count :longest (sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
